neighbours.label: ' get' (' got') in a phrase about starting or returning to an activity (get started, get to work, get back to, get up)
fire: Check the tire pressure before you get started on the trip.
She made coffee, then got to work on the report.
I should really get back to my homework now.
Take a short walk before you get up to speak.
Read the safety notes before you get going.
We had to get moving before it got dark.
After lunch I got back to fixing the fence.
Stretch a little before you get to work.
quiet: Check the tire pressure before you buy a new car.
She made coffee, then got a letter from her aunt.
I should really get a new phone for my homework.
Take a short walk to get some milk.
Read the safety notes on the box you got.
We had to get tickets before it got dark.
After lunch I got a sandwich for the road.
Stretch a little and get a towel from the shelf.

short: get started / get to work / get back to
